labs.name: CKA 1 · Warm-up: Core Concepts
labs.description: Start here. The basics every CKA task builds on: pods, static pods, storage, multi-container pods, RBAC, NetworkPolicy, Deployments and Services, resources, ConfigMaps and probes.

labs.name: CKA 2 · Mock Exam A
labs.description: Full 2-hour mock exam: ConfigMap troubleshooting, RBAC, node maintenance, static PV/PVC, three-tier NetworkPolicies, Helm, RBAC auditing, HPA, TLS Ingress, scheduler troubleshooting, StatefulSets, quotas, Pod Security and sidecars. Adapted from theplatformlab's Mock Exam 01 (MIT).

labs.name: CKA 3 · Mock Exam B
labs.description: Second full mock exam: DNS, rollbacks, Secrets, DaemonSets with tolerations, API server health, ConfigMap reloads, PriorityClasses, NodePort, CronJobs, CSR certificates, PDBs, CRDs, Pod Security, dynamic provisioning and quotas. Adapted from theplatformlab's Mock Exam 02 (MIT).

labs.name: CKA 4 · Advanced Administration
labs.description: Long and dense (20 tasks): storage classes and PVs, autoscaling, affinity, taints, Pod Security, StatefulSets, DNS, Helm, Kustomize, Gateway API, quotas, RBAC, NetworkPolicies, rolling updates, priorities and troubleshooting.

labs.name: CKA 5 · Troubleshooting & Cluster Operations
labs.description: Troubleshooting-heavy with less hand-holding: broken Deployments, Services, scheduling and DNS, logs and metrics, node drain, RBAC, CRDs, Ingress, NetworkPolicies, DaemonSets, CronJobs, native sidecars, PV reclaim policy, ServiceAccount kubeconfigs and topology spread.

labs.name: CKA 6 · Final Exam Simulation
labs.description: Closest to the current exam style: reuse a Released PV, render a Helm chart without CRDs, native sidecars, HPA behavior, CRDs and kubectl explain, PriorityClasses, dedicated nodes, Ingress-to-Gateway migration, Ingress troubleshooting, least-permissive NetworkPolicy, StorageClasses, NodePort, TLS config and kubectl patch.

labs.name: Helm Fundamentals
labs.description: Helm drills: repositories, search, install, upgrade, rollback, values files, creating and packaging a chart, a local chart repository and debugging a broken release.
